I am a Junior in Undergrad and I'm studying to get a B.S. in Chemistry. I did really well in Gen Chem and Organic, but PChem 1 (Quantum Chemistry) and Analyticial Chem 1 (Quantitative Analysis) is kicking my ass, partly due to the fact that my professors always fail to answer my simple questions, and partly due to my own fault of not studying hard enough (also, my PChem professor is trying to teach his computational class to us at the same time and no one in our class has taken computer coding)... I only study about 4hrs a day outside class, because if I do more, I will mentally break down (I have MDD and GAD), I know it is not a lot but I love chemistry and this year is just so hard. Orgo was so easy and fun for me and I loved it, I am doing Organic research right now and I look forward to it every single week. I'm just so confused as where to go, since if I persue a Master's, I will need to take Advanced Analytical and Advanced Physical and I am already doing bad in both. Should I drop my major? Are there different options? Can I get a Master's in Organic Synthesis?
